description: This file manages Nextcloud Talk room information, including caching room types, reading API passwords, and resolving room kinds via API calls.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkRoomKind
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the kind ('direct' or 'group') of a Nextcloud Talk room based on account info and room token, utilizing caching and API requests.

methods.name: resetRoomCache
methods.description: Resets the room cache for testing purposes.
